A resolved 10-leaf packet itself had no direct validator/renderer, so a crew member had to mentally bridge the minimum projection back into the larger handoff machinery.
after: The same canonical 10-leaf packet can be validated and rendered directly with node tools/crew-turn.mjs <packet.json> [--json]. No schema, queue, route, state store, actor identity, priority, NOW, or effect authority was added.
observed_delta: Added lib/field-crew-turn.mjs as an actor-neutral normalizer, tools/crew-turn.mjs as a direct validator/renderer, tools/field-crew-turn-selftest.mjs as the focused invariant test, extended the CI-visible field-machine-reducer selftest to exercise the direct path, and documented the helper in llms.txt. CHANGED/UNCHANGED without evidence fails closed; RETURN emits next_authority NONE.
residue: The crew seam now has three unequal layers with one object identity: natural-language/operator intake → full submission/stage-handoff while host resolution is needed → 10-leaf field-crew-turn once object+owner are exact. The minimum packet is closure-oriented rather than a task store: one delta, one move, one observed result, exact RETURN.
unknowns: CI and pull-request exact-head proof have not yet run for this candidate.
No claim is made that every future external agent protocol can consume field-crew-turn/v0.1 without an adapter.
Human ordinary-use legibility of the one-line shorthand remains an observation, not a merge gate.
unresolved_gate: Exact-head repository verification: machine-reducer/JIT handoff test, static/public gates, gitleaks and current ancestry.
follow_up: If merged, use field-crew-turn/v0.1 only after object+owner are resolved; otherwise remain in the full submission/handoff path.
If another crew system needs interoperability, write an adapter to/from these ten leaves rather than extending the packet with actor/session/priority/NEXT state.
Measure actual handoff failures before adding fields. The first acceptable extension must correspond to a repeated observed loss that cannot live in evidence, gate, owner, or RETURN.
stop: Do not turn this validator into a queue, shared memory, planner, agent roster, lifecycle database, or autonomous NEXT selector.
